item_description:
Script: dpe tshugs.
Volume number in the left margin: ka
Two sets of folio numbers by different hands, with the same numbering.
Annotations in dbu med.
Numerous abbreviations.
Likely, color was used in the original, and appears blurred in the reproduction.
Miniatures on fol. 1b, with caption "ston pa sangs rgyas la na mo" on the left, and "rje btsun byaMs pa la na mo" on the right.
Miniatures on fol. 2a, with caption "'phgas pa thogs med la na mo" on the let, and "slob dpon dbyig gnyen la na mo" on the right.
